[[File:Clans-TPJ.png|thumb|right|220px|Younglings find support through their clan members]]
The '''clans''' of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] were small groupings of ten to twenty [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] that made up the classes of the [[Jedi academy|academy]] within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Overview==
While clans had existed within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for [[Time/Legends|centuries]], it was not until the authoring of ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'' by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Fae Coven]] and a series of other [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] that each clan was detailed and entered into the Order's canon. An Initiate entered into a clan when they reached age three or, in case of other species, the equivalent in maturity. Each clan was designed to appeal to the traits of its members, while placement of each [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|student]] fell to the fosterers in the nurseries at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], who watched the children since infancy. Jedi considered these clans as families, and, since they were colleagues in the [[The Force|Force]], viewed their fellow students closer than any brother or sister. The bonds formed in these clans were essential for sustaining the Order. As each clan moved through the [[Jedi academy|academy]], it was tended to by an [[Jedi instructor|instructor]] responsible for the primary education of the members of their clan. While the academy taught specialized courses, instructors taught more basic lessons that reinforced the rest of their lessons.<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

During the Order's history there were many, many clans including but not limited to:

*[[Bear Clan/Legends|Bear Clan]]<ref name="TJP" />
*[[Bergruutfa Clan]]<ref name="TJP" />
*[[Boma Clan]]<ref name="TJP" />
*[[Clawmouse Clan]]<ref name="TJP" />
*[[Dragon Clan]]<ref name="TJP" />
*[[Heliost Clan/Legends|Heliost Clan]]<ref name="TJP" />
*[[Katarn Clan]]<ref name="TJP" />
*[[Savrip Clan]]<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref>
*[[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]]<ref name="Star Wars: Dark Times: Parallels">''[[Star Wars: Dark Times: Parallels]]''</ref>
*[[Squall Clan]]<ref name="TJP" />
*[[Thranta Clan/Legends|Thranta Clan]]<ref name="TJP" />
*[[Tra'cor Clan]]<ref name="TJP" />
*[[Wolf Clan]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|332|Wolf Clan}}</ref>
*[[Unidentified Clan|Two]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Unidentified Jedi clan|clans]]<ref name="JA7">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Captive Temple]]''</ref> whose names were lost to history

Following the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] did not initially form clans as he began to [[New Jedi Order|rebuild]] the Jedi Order. Reflecting that leaving out this stage of instruction might have had something to do with two of his students' fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], he reintroduced the idea with the launching of the [[Ronto Clan|Ronto]] and [[Veermok Clan]] following his recovery of a copy of ''The Jedi Path''.<ref name="TJP" />

These clans came to include the following:

*[[Bantha Clan]]<ref name="LOTJI">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>
*[[Ronto Clan]]<ref name="TJP" />
*[[Veermok Clan]]<ref name="TJP" />
*[[Wampa Clan]]<ref name="LOTJI" />
*[[Woodoos|Woodoo Clan]]<ref name="LOTJI" />
